title: HandyPro of Farmington Hills Enhances Home Accessibility with Specialized Modification Services | User | dailytimesleader.com
text:
In addition to providing home repairs in a wide range of services, HandyPro offers comprehensive home modifications services to help seniors and people with physical challenges navigate their homes safely and independently
(PRUnderground) March 26th, 2025
HandyPro of Farmington Hills is proud to offer specialized home modification services aimed at improving accessibility and safety for seniors and individuals with disabilities. By utilizing universal design principles, HandyPro provides customized solutions that enable clients to maintain independence and comfort within their own homes.
HandyPro’s Certified Craftsmen deliver a wide range of ADA-compliant home modifications tailored to meet the unique needs of each client, including:​
Mobility Ramps: Installation of ramps to facilitate easy and safe access to and from the home.​ Accessibility Lifts: Implementation of stairlifts, wheelchair lifts, and ceiling lift systems to enhance movement within multi-level residences. Bathroom Accessibility Remodeling: Renovations such as walk-in tubs, roll-in showers, and strategically placed grab bars to ensure safety and ease of use.​ Door Widening and Countertop Adjustments: Modifications to accommodate mobility aids and improve overall accessibility.​ Understanding that each individual’s requirements are unique, HandyPro offers the AIM (Assess, Implement, Modify) in-home assessment. This comprehensive evaluation allows their team to identify specific challenges and recommend personalized solutions to enhance home accessibility and safety.
“With a Commitment to Independence and Comfort our mission is to transform houses into personalized havens of comfort, safety, and joy,” said a representative of HandyPro of Farmington Hills. “We are dedicated to providing innovative and compassionate solutions that empower individuals to fully embrace and enjoy their homes.”
For more information or to schedule an AIM in-home assessment, call HandyPro of Farmington Hills at 248-476-4435 or visit their website at https://www.handypro.com/locations/farmington-hills
About HandyPro of Farmington Hills
HandyPro of Farmington Hills is a trusted provider of handyman and home modification services, committed to delivering exceptional craftsmanship and customer satisfaction. With a focus on accessibility solutions, HandyPro aims to enhance the quality of life for seniors and individuals with disabilities by enabling them to live comfortably and safely in their own homes. HandyPro serves Auburn Hills, Beverly Hills, Birmingham, Bloomfield Hills, Canton, Farmington, Farmington Hills, Keego Harbor, Lathrup Village, Livonia, Lyon Twp, Madison Heights, Northville, Novi, Oak Park, Orchard Lake Village, Oxford Twp, Plymouth, Rochester Hills, Southfield, Troy, West Bloomfield, Wixom, Wolverine Lake, and neighboring communities.
